Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O03.6.2
Parent: O03.6 (bd-01M4XPCN6RSRCS8CB96BR5Y8GY)
Plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Scope: Implementation slice of O03.6; parent acceptance is unchanged. Enroll current catalog authority and integrate synchronous policy durability.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Inventory every supported authority mutation and all current eligibility/lifecycle inputs. Under a fenced closed maintenance window export complete current authority, tombstones, immutable historical event identity and credentials/leases without secrets; unsupported nondefault state and producer versions fail closed.
2. Add an additive schema and trusted adapter at PolicySql.commit: bounded verified PREPARE precedes any visible local commit; effects, invalidations, event and pending receipt commit atomically; verified remote COMMIT precedes completed success. Preserve old migration and historical event bytes.
3. Reconcile ambiguous local/remote outcomes under the live catalog exclusive guard by exact operation ID and payload. Explicit ABORT requires proven live absence; restored backup absence never authorizes it. Pending restrictions apply locally, no write overtakes them, and credential issuance never duplicates a lost-response operation.
4. Integrate independently retained trust with service/operator configuration and least-privilege roles. Startup and every runtime admission validate installation, epoch and heads with permits no longer than five seconds and bounded drain; barrier fencing must stop the old service independently of restored database fields.
5. Return explicit pending/outcome-unknown/durably acknowledged status and redacted readiness. Test actual supported mutation classes, current local authorization, unsupported capability refusal and failed event rollback. Keep organization restore blocked pending O03.7/O03.8.

Evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.6.2/receipt.json
Completion: every criterion requires observed evidence; planning closes no work. Parent and organization recovery remain open until integrated qualification.
